body.name: unequal-information annotation-frontier handle
body.construction: Determine an explicit elementary function \(r_\epsilon(n,m,d)\) by optimizing the approximation degree and heavy--light threshold when each admissible monomial contains at most one outcome-marked factor estimated from \(\mathcal L_n\), while all remaining treatment--mass factorial factors are estimated from the pooled \(N=n+m\) treatment--covariate records; the expression must be capped for every \(n,m,d\) and contain no optimization over \(P\).
